name: probler-e2e
description: Playwright end-to-end suite for probler, driven against a real KIND-deployed cluster.

scripts.lint:scratch: test -z "$(find tests -name 'zzz-*')" || (echo 'scratch specs left behind:'; find tests -name 'zzz-*'; exit 1)
scripts.lint:sleep: test -z "$(grep -rnE 'waitForTimeout\(|(^|[^.[:alnum:]_])setTimeout\(' tests pages drivers fixtures)" || (echo 'fixed sleeps found -- wait on an event or condition instead:'; grep -rnE 'waitForTimeout\(|(^|[^.[:alnum:]_])setTimeout\(' tests pages drivers fixtures; exit 1)
